title: `SQLITE_ENABLE_SETLK_TIMEOUT` + `sqlite3_setlk_timeout` on every connection
impact: Downgraded from Accepted after 5-run confirmation: original single-run p99/max wins were noise (baseline outlier that never reproduced). Multi-run median shows p99 +74 % to +172 % worse and max +29 % to +529 % worse on writes; noop regresses even though it has no lock contention. Needs a concurrent-reader harness + shorter timeout to be evaluable
